title: Count Anagram Groups
statement:
Given N words, group them by anagram class and print the number of distinct groups.

Two words belong to the same group if they are anagrams of each other.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^4
1 <= |word| <= 20
All words contain only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The next N lines each contain one word.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of distinct anagram groups.

examples.input:
6
eat
tea
tan
ate
nat
bat
examples.explanation: Group 1: eat, tea, ate. Group 2: tan, nat. Group 3: bat. Total = 3.
abc and bca are anagrams (group 1), xyz is alone (group 2).
